links.outcome: Field-level accuracy, omission, and fabrication of LLM-generated summaries versus staff-authored summaries
links.effect: Fabrication ≤2% per field; nodal status accuracy 95% v 72%, invasive tumor on biopsy 94% v 30%; staff more accurate for receptor status 96% v 86%; patient-level fabrication 8% AI vs 3% staff.
links.quote: At the patient level, fabrication occurred in 16 AI-generated summaries (8%), including six clinically significant cases (3%).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of a retrieval-augmented LLM system for generating preconsult summaries in breast surgical oncology compared against staff-authored summaries.
